title: prunella vulgaris f. albiflora
intro: Prunella vulgaris f. albiflora, commonly known as White Selfheal, is a flowering plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the skin, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of White Selfheal include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, which may be useful in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Prunella vulgaris f. albiflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
